UIDAI offers free Aadhaar email updates via app

The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has introduced a new feature allowing Aadhaar holders to update their email addresses free of charge. This service is accessible through the official UIDAI mobile application and is currently available for a six-month period. The move aims to enhance digital services and user convenience for Aadhaar-related information.
